transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to review the internal platform maintenance train plan before I publish it. As a reminder, the train runs across four consecutive weeks: October 6-10, October 13-17, October 20-24, and October 27-31. The draft plan currently has CI-runner cleanup in week 1, crypto-dependency upgrade in week 2, database-indexing cleanup in week 3, and certificate automation in week 4. My standard review process goes through backend, infrastructure, QA, and release coordination in that order, so I'd like to work through each of your areas and make sure the dates and commitments look right before we finalize.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The crypto-dependency upgrade replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning, I found that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if cleanup moves to week 1 as Ravi's crypto dependency might require, we'd need to account for the fact that the safe retirement of those 14 idle runners is tied to draining active build queues, which I've confirmed is feasible in week 4.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the test-environment owner today that the dedicated staging environment needed to validate certificate automation is available only during October 20-24, which is week 3. This means certificate automation must be the week-3 workstream. I haven't posted the reservation yet because the environment owner confirmed it only minutes ago.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I confirmed this afternoon that the partner team has a production deploy freeze from October 20-31, so database-indexing cleanup must be completed in the October 13-17 window and needs a partner-coordination commitment. I haven't changed the release calendar yet because the partner approval arrived by email after the calendar review.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Move crypto-dependency upgrade to week 1 (October 6-10) so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends; Ravi to update the maintenance ticket with the confirmed payment-service dependency.

Schedule database-indexing cleanup in week 2 (October 13-17) to complete before the partner production deploy freeze (October 20-31); Nadia to update the release calendar with the partner-coordination commitment.
Schedule certificate automation in week 3 (October 20-24) when the dedicated staging environment is available; Tom to post the environment reservation once confirmed.

Schedule CI-runner cleanup in week 4 (October 27-31) after active build queues are drained, retiring exactly 14 idle CI runners; Elise to close the billing investigation and correct the runner inventory once retirement is complete.
